description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L2585-2805: 14 tests for Vim-style Ctrl+] jump-to-char (press Ctrl+], wait for char input, jump cursor to next/previous occurrence). Elixir has NO such feature. Implementation + full test port required. Decide whether to implement or document as a non-goal — if declined, document divergence and close the child explicitly.

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Character jump (Ctrl+])" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Character jump (Ctrl+])" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Character jump (Ctrl+])" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).
